pillars.subtitle: What Sets Us Apart
pillars.title: The Four Pillars of Our Excellence
pillars.desc: Ziquala Abo School combines academic learning, character formation, discipline, and community responsibility.

items.title: Integrity
items.desc: Doing what is right, always. We foster honesty and accountability in every interaction. Character is defined by what you do when no one is watching.

items.title: Leadership
items.desc: Cultivating the potential within. We empower students to take initiative, find their voice, build confidence, and inspire others.

items.title: Success
items.desc: A holistic mindset. We define success by resilience and the pursuit of one's full potential — not just a GPA.

items.title: Lifelong Learning
items.desc: Staying curious. Our inquiry-based curriculum moves beyond rote memorization to encourage creative thinking and innovation.

vision.subtitle: Our Vision
vision.desc: To empower our community through a premier 21st-century learning experience that balances academic rigor with ethical purpose. We strive to cultivate Ethiopia's future entrepreneurs, inventors, and scholars — equipping them to lead with innovation, creativity, and integrity.
vision.missionDesc: To provide equitable, high-quality education that connects modern knowledge with spiritual wisdom and strong ethical values.

features.label: Ethical Leadership
features.desc: Ensuring success is always guided by strong moral values

community.quote: "Together — as students, parents, and teachers — we don't just build a school; we build the future of Ethiopia."

uniform.desc: Our uniform is more than a dress code — it reflects our collective identity, high standards, and commitment to inclusion. When students dress with purpose, they learn with purpose.
